sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看起来凶手费尽心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Around 3pm on Wednesday, September 20, 2017, a resident in the Southfields district of southwest London was disturbed by a foul odour.
sentences.zh: 2017年9月20日星期三下午3点左右，伦敦西南部南菲尔德斯地区的的一位居民闻到了一股刺鼻的恶臭。

sentences.en: Peering outside, they noticed a black smoke emanating from their next-door neighbour's rear garden, from what appeared to be some kind of weird barbecue.
sentences.zh: 他探头向外望去，发现隔壁邻居的后花园里冒出滚滚黑烟，似乎是在进行某种奇怪的烧烤。

sentences.en: The concerned resident went and knocked on their neighbour's door to check if everything was okay, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 这位热心的居民前去敲响了邻居的门，想看看是不是出了什么事，但无人应答。

sentences.en: Shrugging it off, they went about their day, as the repugnant smoke continued to spiral above their neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 他没把这放在心上，继续过自己的日子，而那股令人作呕的浓烟仍在他们社区上空盘旋。

sentences.en: Three hours later, the resident could no longer ignore it.
sentences.zh: 三小时后，这位居民再也无法忽视这股气味了。

sentences.en: They phoned emergency services and reported the strange fire burning on Wimbledon Park Road.
sentences.zh: 他拨打了紧急求助电话，举报了温布尔登公园路上这场奇怪的火灾。

sentences.en: Firefighters arrived at the address at 6.20pm.
sentences.zh: 消防员于傍晚6点20分抵达现场。

sentences.en: A slim, balding man with olive skin and greying facial hair opened the door.
sentences.zh: 一名身材消瘦、谢顶、皮肤呈橄榄色且面部胡须花白的男子打开了门。

sentences.en: He was 40-year-old Wiesem Medoni, known to friends as Sam.
sentences.zh: 他便是40岁的维瑟姆·梅多尼（Wiesem Medoni），朋友们都叫他萨姆（Sam）。

sentences.en: Wiesem told the firefighters there was nothing to worry about, he was simply having a barbecue.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆告诉消防员没什么好担心的，他只是在进行烧烤。

sentences.en: But the firefighters wanted to check it out to make sure it didn't present any fire hazards.
sentences.zh: 但消防员想要检查一下，以确保不存在任何火灾隐患。

sentences.en: They walked through Wiesem's small two-bedroom flat and out a set of French doors into the rear garden.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过维瑟姆狭小的两居室公寓，通过一组法式玻璃门走进了后花园。

sentences.en: Just as Wiesem had described, several pieces of chicken were grilling on a small barbecue.
sentences.zh: 正如维瑟姆所描述的那样，一个小型烧烤架上正烤着几块鸡肉。

sentences.en: Alongside it blazed an open bonfire, which was the source of the thick, foul-smelling smoke.
sentences.zh: 旁边还燃着一堆露天篝火，正是这堆篝火散发出了刺鼻的浓烟。

sentences.en: The fire was remarkably close to the door, so firefighters deemed it a hazard and extinguished the flames.
sentences.zh: 火势离房门非常近，因此消防员认为存在安全隐患并将其扑灭了。

sentences.en: One of them, Thomas Hunt, then turned to Wiesem and asked what he was burning.
sentences.zh: 其中一名消防员托马斯·亨特（Thomas Hunt）随后转身问维瑟姆烧的是什么。

sentences.en: Wiesem said it was the carcass of a sheep, which he'd purchased earlier from the Wimbledon markets.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆说是一具羊的尸体，是他早些时候从温布尔登市场买来的。

sentences.en: Thomas eyed the charred remains.
sentences.zh: 托马斯端详着焦黑的残骸。

sentences.en: Among two blackened logs were human fingers and a nose.
sentences.zh: 在两根熏黑的圆木之间，竟然有人类的手指和鼻子。

sentences.en: Upon realising that he was looking at the remnants of a human body, firefighter Thomas Hunt wanted to confront Wiesem Medigny.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己眼前看到的是一具人类尸体的残骸后，消防员托马斯·亨特想要质问维瑟姆·梅迪尼（Wiesem Medigny）。

sentences.en: But he wasn't sure how the man would react and didn't want to put the rest of his team in danger.
sentences.zh: 但他不确定这名男子会有什么反应，也不想让其余的队员陷入危险之中。

sentences.en: Thomas paused for a moment.
sentences.zh: 托马斯停顿了一会儿。

sentences.en: In response to Wiesem's claim that he was burning a sheep carcass, Thomas finally said,
sentences.zh: 针对维瑟姆声称自己在烧羊尸体的说法，托马斯最终说道：

sentences.en: Bollocks.
sentences.zh: 胡说八道。

sentences.en: Wiesem seemed unperturbed.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆似乎并未受到影响。

sentences.en: He calmly shrugged off the comment and went to sit down.
sentences.zh: 他平静地耸了耸肩，走过去坐了下来。

sentences.en: It was then that Thomas detected a look of resignation on Wiesem's face, as though he knew he'd been caught.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，托马斯从维瑟姆脸上捕捉到了一种认命的表情，仿佛他知道自己已经暴露了。

sentences.en: While waiting for police to arrive, the firefighters sifted through the ashes and found items of clothing, jewellery and a pair of badly charred eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 在等待警察到达的同时，消防员们在灰烬中搜寻，找到了衣物、首饰以及一副严重烧焦的眼镜。

sentences.en: Pieces of cooked chicken had also been thrown on the burning body in a crass attempt to disguise it.
sentences.zh: 燃烧的尸体上还被扔了一些煮熟的鸡肉，这是一种拙劣的伪装手段。

sentences.en: There was something else adding to the disturbing nature of the discovery.
sentences.zh: 还有一些其他细节加剧了这一发现令人不安的性质。

sentences.en: The body looked particularly small and frail.
sentences.zh: 这具尸体看起来异常娇小瘦弱。

sentences.en: For the fire crew, this indicated one thing.
sentences.zh: 对消防队员来说，这说明了一件事。

sentences.en: That it was the body of a child.
sentences.zh: 这是一具儿童的尸体。

sentences.en: The police soon arrived and assessed the scene.
sentences.zh: 警察很快赶到并对现场进行了评估。

sentences.en: The body was so badly burned that they couldn't determine the person's age or gender.
sentences.zh: 尸体烧焦得如此严重，以至于他们无法确定死者的年龄或性别。

sentences.en: They asked Wiesem who it was.
sentences.zh: 他们问维瑟姆这是谁。

sentences.en: He simply responded,
sentences.zh: 他只是简单地回答：

sentences.en: It's not a child.
sentences.zh: 这不是个孩子。

sentences.en: 36-year-old Sabrina Quader was a glamorous woman.
sentences.zh: 36岁的萨布丽娜·夸德尔（Sabrina Quader）是一个风情万种的女人。

sentences.en: Born in Algeria but raised in Paris, she took great pride in her appearance.
sentences.zh: 她出生于阿尔及利亚，但在巴黎长大，她对自己的外表感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: With long dark hair, olive skin, and a keen sense of style, she was often mistaken for reality TV star Kim Kardashian.
sentences.zh: 她留着长长的黑发，皮肤呈橄榄色，对时尚有着敏锐的触觉，经常被人误认为是真人秀明星金·卡戴珊（Kim Kardashian）。

sentences.en: Having established herself as a successful fashion designer and makeup artist,
sentences.zh: 随着自己成为一名成功的时装设计师和化妆师，

sentences.en: Sabrina was awarded with invites to trendy events where she mingled with the rich and famous.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜收到了许多时尚活动的邀请，得以与名流富豪们交际。

sentences.en: Sabrina met Wiesem Medigny at a Parisian fun fair in 2001.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜于2001年在巴黎的一处游乐场结识了维瑟姆·梅迪尼。

sentences.en: Wiesem had been immediately struck by her beauty and it wasn't long before he was completely besotted with her.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆立刻被她的美貌所吸引，不久便对她神魂颠倒。

sentences.en: Sabrina eventually moved from Paris to London and Wiesem, also a French-Algerian, happily followed her.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜最终从巴黎搬到了伦敦，同样具有法阿混血背景的维瑟姆也高兴地追随她而去。

sentences.en: They'd called England home ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他们便以英国为家。

sentences.en: The couple had periods of separation throughout their 17-year-long relationship, during which Sabrina had two children to two different men,
sentences.zh: 在他俩长达17年的恋爱关系中，曾有过几段分分合合的时期，期间萨布丽娜为两个不同的男人生过两个孩子，

sentences.en: but she and Wiesem always wound up back together.
sentences.zh: 但她和维瑟姆最终总能重归于好。

sentences.en: They'd been living in the rented Wimbledon Park Road flat since 2013.
sentences.zh: 自2013年起，他们一直住在温布尔登公园路那间租来的公寓里。

sentences.en: Following the discovery of the burnt human remains at the couple's home,
sentences.zh: 在这对情侣的家中发现烧焦的人体残骸之后，

sentences.en: Wiesem Medigny was placed in handcuffs and escorted to the police station.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆·梅迪尼被戴上手铐并被押送至警察局。

sentences.en: Police attempted to interview him, but Wiesem remained silent when questioned.
sentences.zh: 警方试图对其实施讯问，但维瑟姆在受审时保持沉默。

sentences.en: When Sabrina Quader returned home with her two young sons, there was a collective sense of relief that her and her children were safe.
sentences.zh: 当萨布丽娜·夸德尔带着两个年幼的儿子回到家时，大家普遍松了一口气，因为她和孩子们都很安全。

sentences.en: But the question remained, whose body was found in the pyre?
sentences.zh: 但问题依然存在，火堆里的尸体究竟是谁？

sentences.en: Sabrina was stunned by the police presence and asked what was going on.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜被警察的出现惊呆了，并询问发生了什么事。

sentences.en: An officer told her that Wiesem was found burning a body in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 一名警官告诉她，维瑟姆被发现正在后院焚烧尸体。

sentences.en: This came as a huge shock to Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 这对萨布丽娜来说是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: She said she'd been out all day and that things at home seemed completely normal when she left.
sentences.zh: 她称自己一整天都在外面，而且她离开时家里的情况一切正常。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, she picked up her children from school and took them to an after-school club, at which time Wiesem endeavoured to burn the unidentified body in their back garden.
sentences.zh: 下午，她接孩子们放学并把他们带到一个课后俱乐部，正是在这段时间里，维瑟姆试图在他们的后花园里焚烧那具身份不明的尸体。

sentences.en: Sabrina couldn't believe what she was hearing.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜简直不敢相信自己听到的话。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, police questioned the couple's neighbours to see if they'd noticed anything out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方走访了这对情侣的邻居，看他们是否注意到任何异常情况。

sentences.en: Southfields was an affluent, family-oriented suburb labelled as one of the best places to live in London and crimes of this nature were unheard of.
sentences.zh: 南菲尔德斯是一个富裕且适合家庭居住的郊区，被誉为伦敦最宜居的地区之一，此类犯罪闻所未闻。

sentences.en: Neighbours were in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 邻居们感到难以置信。

sentences.en: They knew the residents of the house to be a relatively normal family that mostly kept to themselves.
sentences.zh: 据他们所知，这栋房子的住户是一个相对正常的家庭，平时大多闭门不出。

sentences.en: They weren't very involved with the community and didn't attend street parties, but there was nothing much else to note.
sentences.zh: 他们不太参与社区活动，也不参加街头派对，但除此之外没有什么特别值得注意的。

sentences.en: No one had seen or heard anything untoward in the days leading up to the fire.
sentences.zh: 在火灾发生前的几天里，没有人看到或听到任何异常情况。

sentences.en: When they thought about it, however, they realised they hadn't seen the couple's young nanny in weeks.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他们仔细回想时，却意识到他们已经好几周没见到这对情侣的年轻保姆了。

sentences.en: She was often sighted out and about running errands for her host family and picking up Sabrina's children from school.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到她外出为雇主家跑腿办事，并接送萨布丽娜的孩子们放学。

sentences.en: But not lately.
sentences.zh: 但最近没有了。

sentences.en: What's more, neighbours had described her as wearing eyeglasses similar to those found in the fire.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，邻居们还形容她戴着一副与火灾现场发现的眼镜相似的眼镜。

sentences.en: When asked about her nanny, Sabrina Quader claimed she had resigned two days earlier and returned home to France.
sentences.zh: 当被问及保姆时，萨布丽娜·夸德尔声称她两天前已经辞职并返回法国的家中。

sentences.en: Police asked for the nanny's name, but Sabrina could only remember her first name, Sophie.
sentences.zh: 警方询问保姆的名字，但萨布丽娜只记得她的名字叫苏菲（Sophie）。

sentences.en: She had hired Sophie 18 months prior to help with the children while Wiesem was away for work.
sentences.zh: 她在18个月前雇用了苏菲，以便在维瑟姆外出工作时代为照顾孩子。

sentences.en: This immediately struck the police as odd.
sentences.zh: 这顿时让警方觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: After employing and living with Sophie for such a long time, it seemed absurd that Sabrina didn't know her last name.
sentences.zh: 在雇用并与苏菲同住了这么长时间后，萨布丽娜竟然不知道她的姓氏，这显得荒谬至极。

sentences.en: They suspected that Sabrina knew more than she was letting on and took her to the station for further questioning.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑萨布丽娜有所隐瞒，遂将其带回警察局作进一步讯问。

sentences.en: Given the level of destruction,
sentences.zh: 鉴于破坏程度极其严重，

sentences.en: DNA testing would be required to confirm the identity of the body Wiesem was attempting to destroy.
sentences.zh: 必须进行DNA检测才能确认维瑟姆企图销毁的那具尸体的身份。

sentences.en: But police were certain it was the couple's live-in nanny, 21-year-old Sophie Leonet.
sentences.zh: 但警方确信这就是这对情侣的住家保姆，21岁的苏菲·莱奥内（Sophie Leonet）。

sentences.en: When faced with this revelation, Sabrina caved.
sentences.zh: 面对这一真相，萨布丽娜崩溃了。

sentences.en: She revealed that Sophie was incompetent at her job and didn't do any of the tasks she was hired to do.
sentences.zh: 她透露，苏菲工作能力很差，根本不干任何她被雇用要做的工作。

sentences.en: Instead, she lazed around on the couch glued to her smartphone.
sentences.zh: 相反，她只是懒散地躺在沙发上，双眼紧盯着智能手机。

sentences.en: Sabrina said,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜说：

sentences.en: She said that Sophie had fallen in with the wrong crowd and had been drinking heavily.
sentences.zh: 她称苏菲误交了损友，并且酗酒严重。

sentences.en: Sabrina also suspected that she had been stealing from her as a diamond pendant had gone missing from the house.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜还怀疑她一直在偷窃自己的东西，因为家里少了一颗钻石吊坠。

sentences.en: Sophie's behaviour soon took a sinister turn.
sentences.zh: 苏菲的行为很快变得险恶起来。

sentences.en: Sabrina discovered she had begun a relationship with Sabrina's ex-boyfriend, a man named Mark Walton, who was the biological father of Sabrina's youngest son.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜发现她与萨布丽娜的前男友开始了一段恋情，此人名叫马克·沃尔顿（Mark Walton），是萨布丽娜小儿子的亲生父亲。

sentences.en: Sabrina revealed that Mark had sexually abused their son and that Sophie had been allowing it to happen.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜透露，马克曾性虐待他们的儿子，而苏菲对此一直纵容。

sentences.en: Not only allowing it, but facilitating the meetings by bringing the young boy to Mark without Sabrina's knowledge.
sentences.zh: 不仅纵容，甚至还在萨布丽娜不知情的情况下，把小男孩带去见马克，从而为两人的会面提供便利。

sentences.en: When Wiesem found out what was happening, it was the final straw.
sentences.zh: 当维瑟姆发现这一切时，这成了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: Days earlier, at around midnight on Monday September 18,
sentences.zh: 几天前，即9月18日星期一午夜左右，

sentences.en: Sabrina was sleeping when Wiesem came into the room and woke her up.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜正在睡觉，维瑟姆走进房间把她叫醒了。

sentences.en: He told her he had confronted Sophie about the meetings with Mark and the abuse against Sabrina's son.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，自己曾就与马克的会面以及对萨布丽娜儿子的虐待一事质问过苏菲。

sentences.en: He lost his temper and hit Sophie, causing her to fly back and hit her head against the bathroom wall.
sentences.zh: 他当时情绪失控打了苏菲，导致她向后飞去，头部撞到了浴室墙壁上。

sentences.en: Her body stopped moving.
sentences.zh: 她的身体停止了动弹。

sentences.en: It was obvious that she was dead.
sentences.zh: 很明显，她已经死了。

sentences.en: Wiesem and Sabrina panicked.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆和萨布丽娜惊慌失措。

sentences.en: They were scared of what it might mean for their family if they told the truth.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕如果说出真相，会对他们的家庭意味着什么。

sentences.en: They couldn't risk it.
sentences.zh: 他们不敢冒这个险。

sentences.en: They decided to keep Sophie's death a secret and burn her body so no one would ever find out.
sentences.zh: 他们决定对苏菲的死保密，并焚烧她的尸体，这样就没人会知道了。

sentences.en: If anyone asked where she was, they'd simply say she had decided to return home to France.
sentences.zh: 如果有人问起她去了哪里，他们就会直截了当说她决定回法国老家了。

sentences.en: They stashed her belongings in her suitcase, which they hid inside their small garden shed.
sentences.zh: 他们把她的随身物品塞进手提箱，藏在了他们的小花园棚里。

sentences.en: When pressed, Wiesem Medouni backed Sabrina's claiMs.
sentences.zh: 在受到追问时，维瑟姆·梅杜尼（Wiesem Medouni）证实了萨布丽娜的说法。

sentences.en: He said that in an effort to extract information about Mark Walton and the child abuse, he had Sophie sit in a full bath and would periodically hold her head under the water
sentences.zh: 他称为了逼问出有关马克·沃尔顿和虐童事件的信息，他让苏菲坐进装满水的浴缸里，并周期性地将她的头按入水中

sentences.en: to compel her to answer his questions.
sentences.zh: 以此迫使她回答他的问题。

sentences.en: He was eventually so overcome with anger, he punched Sophie in the face, causing her head to strike the tiles.
sentences.zh: 他最终怒火中烧，一拳打在苏菲的脸上，导致她的头部撞击到了瓷砖上。

sentences.en: She lost consciousness, and her body then slipped under the water.
sentences.zh: 她失去了意识，随后身体滑入水中。

sentences.en: Wiesem tried to revive Sophie, explaining that he had never intended to kill her or cause her serious injury.
sentences.zh: 维瑟姆试图救醒苏菲，并解释说他从未想过要杀死她或对她造成严重伤害。

sentences.en: He had simply lost control.
sentences.zh: 他只是失去了控制。

sentences.en: When it was clear she was deceased, he agreed to burning her body to protect his family.
sentences.zh: 当确定她已经死亡后，他同意焚烧她的尸体以保护家人。

sentences.en: Police were baffled by the story, but Sabrina had evidence to back up her claiMs.
sentences.zh: 警方对这个说法感到匪夷所思，但萨布丽娜有证据来支持她的说法。

sentences.en: She produced a confession allegedly penned by Sophie.
sentences.zh: 她拿出了据称由苏菲亲笔写下的供词。

sentences.en: One part read,
sentences.zh: 其中一部分写道：

sentences.en: Mark Walton asked me to come and see him.
sentences.zh: 马克·沃尔顿让我去找他。

sentences.en: He started to touch my breasts and he kissed my neck.
sentences.zh: 他开始摸我的胸部，并亲吻我的脖子。

sentences.en: Mark offered me some money and he asked me to come back with Sabrina's youngest child.
sentences.zh: 马克给了我一些钱，并要求我带着萨布丽娜的小儿子一起回去。

sentences.en: Experts confirmed the handwriting was indeed Sophie's.
sentences.zh: 专家证实，笔迹确实属于苏菲。

sentences.en: Sophie's body had been so badly burnt that the exact cause of her death couldn't be established.
sentences.zh: 苏菲的尸体被烧得如此严重，以至于无法确定她确切的死因。

sentences.en: Her lower jawbone, four of her ribs and her sternum were all found to have been fractured.
sentences.zh: 人们发现她的下颌骨、四根肋骨和胸骨都发生了骨折。

sentences.en: The timing of these injuries were particularly noteworthy.
sentences.zh: 这些伤情发生的时间尤其值得注意。

sentences.en: Forensic experts concluded that the jawbone fracture happened hours before Sophie was killed,
sentences.zh: 法医专家得出结论，下颌骨骨折发生在苏菲遇害前数小时，

sentences.en: hinting that there was more to her bathtub interrogation than Wiesem just holding her head underwater.
sentences.zh: 这暗示她在浴缸中遭受的审讯并不像维瑟姆所说的那样只是把她的头按在水里那么简单。

sentences.en: The chest injuries were even more suspicious.
sentences.zh: 胸部伤势则更加可疑。

sentences.en: They were found to have occurred days before she died.
sentences.zh: 经查明，这些伤是在她死前几天造成的。

sentences.en: Investigators examined Wiesem and Sabrina's mobile phones, and what they found was shocking.
sentences.zh: 调查人员检查了维瑟姆和萨布丽娜的手机，他们发现的内容令人震惊。

sentences.en: Over a 12-day period, the couple had recorded over 8 hours of audio and video footage in which they subjected Sophie to harrowing interrogations.
sentences.zh: 在长达12天的时间里，这对情侣录制了超过8小时的音频和视频素材，在这些素材中，他们对苏菲进行了惨无人道的审讯。

sentences.en: Using violence and coercion, they relentlessly tried to get her to confess to a range of offences.
sentences.zh: 他们通过暴力和胁迫手段，无休止地试图逼迫她承认一系列罪行。

sentences.en: They accused her of being a spy, a thief, a heavy drug user, and a pedophile.
sentences.zh: 他们指控她是间谍、小偷、重度瘾君子以及恋童癖。

sentences.en: But, at the heart of the interrogations lay one person, Mark Walton.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些审讯的核心人物只有一个，那就是马克·沃尔顿。

sentences.en: Sabrina and Wiesem applied immense pressure and intimidation trying to make Sophie admit that she was having a sexual relationship with Mark,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜和维瑟姆施加了巨大的压力和恐吓，企图迫使苏菲承认她与马克存在性关系，

sentences.en: and that the two were in cahoots to sexually exploit Sabrina's sons.
sentences.zh: 并且两人狼狈为奸，意图对萨布丽娜的儿子们进行性剥削。

sentences.en: The couple claimed they had evidence that Sophie had brought Mark to their flat so he could drug and sexually abuse the family.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣声称他们掌握了证据，证明苏菲曾把马克带到他们的公寓，以便马克能够对该家人下药并实施性虐待。

sentences.en: They compared Sophie to a Nazi collaborator and told her she was worse than a murderer.
sentences.zh: 他们将苏菲比作纳粹合作者，并告诉她她比杀人犯还要恶劣。

sentences.en: Sabrina said,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜说：

sentences.en: Sabrina told Sophie that she had friends in high places, including then-US President Donald Trump, and that she could easily have her locked up.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜告诉苏菲，她在高层有人脉，包括时任美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，她可以轻而易举地把她关进监狱。

sentences.en: She threatened Sophie with 40 years in prison, saying,
sentences.zh: 她威胁苏菲说要判处她40年监禁，并说道：

sentences.en: Close your eyes for one minute and imagine yourself every day in a cage like an animal with other people inside.
sentences.zh: 闭上一分钟眼睛，想象一下自己每天像动物一样关在笼子里，里面还有其他人。

sentences.en: That's not a laughing matter.
sentences.zh: 这可不是开玩笑的事。

sentences.en: From the recordings, it was clear that Sabrina was the main instigator.
sentences.zh: 从录音中可以明显看出，萨布丽娜是主要的煽动者。

sentences.en: During one interrogation, she said,
sentences.zh: 在一次审讯中，她说道：

sentences.en: On my mother's life, I am not going to leave you alone.
sentences.zh: 我以我母亲的生命发誓，我绝不会放过你。

sentences.en: I will not touch you, but I will not leave you alone until you tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 我不会动你，但在你对我说出真相之前，我绝不会罢休。

sentences.en: Is this clear?
sentences.zh: 这清楚吗？

sentences.en: Do you understand?
sentences.zh: 你听懂了吗？

sentences.en: You will not go back to France until you've told me the truth.
sentences.zh: 在你告诉我真相之前，你休想回法国。

sentences.en: I am going to spoil your life as you have spoiled mine.
sentences.zh: 我要毁了你的生活，正如你毁了我的生活一样。

sentences.en: Have you understood that?
sentences.zh: 你听懂了吗？

sentences.en: But Wiesem also played a significant role.
sentences.zh: 但威瑟姆也扮演了重要的角色。

sentences.en: In one recording, he called Sophie a liar and told her she wasn't allowed to return back to France until she'd revealed the whole truth and nothing but the truth.
sentences.zh: 在一段录音中，他称索菲为骗子，并告诉她，在她交代全部真相、毫无隐瞒之前，不准回法国。

sentences.en: It was clear that Sophie was terrified.
sentences.zh: 很明显，索菲吓坏了。

sentences.en: She rarely responded to the couple's hounding, but when she did, her voice was meek and barely audible.
sentences.zh: 她很少回应这对夫妇的纠缠，但偶尔开口时，声音也极其微弱，几乎听不见。

sentences.en: At first, and for a long while, she denied everything and seemed genuinely confused about what the couple were accusing her of.
sentences.zh: 起初，在很长一段时间里，她否认了一切，并且对这对夫妇指控她的事情表现得茫然不解。

sentences.en: The extent of the physical violence wasn't clear, but loud thumping sounds indicated that Sabrina hit Sophie multiple times.
sentences.zh: 体力暴力的严重程度尚不清楚，但沉重的撞击声表明萨布丽娜多次殴打索菲。

sentences.en: The final video was filmed shortly before midnight on Monday September 18, 2017.
sentences.zh: 最后一段视频拍摄于2017年9月18日星期一午夜前不久。

sentences.en: Investigators couldn't believe what they were watching.
sentences.zh: 调查人员简直不敢相信他们所看到的画面。

sentences.en: In stark contrast to the healthy, happy young woman who had left France 18 months earlier,
sentences.zh: 与18个月前离开法国时那个健康、快乐的年轻女子形成鲜明对比的是，

sentences.en: Sophie Leonet was a shadow of her former self.
sentences.zh: 索菲·莱奥内已经瘦得不成人形。

sentences.en: Her body was gaunt and skeletal, as though she hadn't eaten in weeks.
sentences.zh: 她的身体消瘦如柴，骨瘦如柴，就像几周没吃过东西一样。

sentences.en: She looked frail and broken.
sentences.zh: 她看起来虚弱不堪，心力交瘁。

sentences.en: Her once thick and wavy brown hair had become thin and flat,
sentences.zh: 她曾经浓密而微卷的棕色头发变得又稀疏又服帖，

sentences.en: This explained why the remains in the fire looked childlike.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了为什么火堆里的遗骸看起来像小孩子一样。

sentences.en: It was heart-wrenching to watch.
sentences.zh: 这一幕实在令人心碎。

sentences.en: The emaciated Sophie sat in front of a fireplace in the Wimbledon Park Road flat, a knitted blanket draped across her lap.
sentences.zh: 骨瘦如柴的索菲坐在温布尔登公园路公寓的壁炉前，膝盖上搭着一条针织毯子。

sentences.en: There, the months of abuse and violent interrogations came to her head.
sentences.zh: 在那里，数月的虐待和残酷审讯涌上她的心头。

sentences.en: Sophie finally broke.
sentences.zh: 索菲终于崩溃了。

sentences.en: She confessed to having an affair with Mark Walton.
sentences.zh: 她承认自己与马克·沃尔顿有染。

sentences.en: In an even more shocking revelation, she admitted that she drugged Wiesem so that Mark could come over to the flat and sexually assault him as well.
sentences.zh: 更令人震惊的是，她承认自己给威瑟姆下了药，好让马克来到公寓并对其实施性侵。

sentences.en: Sabrina and Wiesem intended to hand the footage they had taken of Sophie's confession to police as evidence of her crimes.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜和威瑟姆打算将他们拍摄的索菲供认视频交给警方，作为她犯罪的证据。

sentences.en: However, just hours after Sophie admitted to knowing and abetting Mark Walton, she was dead.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在索菲承认认识并协助马克·沃尔顿几个小时后，她就死了。

sentences.en: Mark Walton was going about his mourning in his new home of Los Angeles when he received a phone call from the police in London.
sentences.zh: 马克·沃尔顿当时正在他位于洛杉矶的新家中悼念，突然接到了伦敦警方的电话。

sentences.en: He was shocked to hear that Sabrina Quider had just accused him of child molestation in collaboration with her nanny, who had just been killed.
sentences.zh: 听到萨布丽娜·奎德刚刚指控他与其刚刚遇害的保姆合谋虐待儿童，他大惊失色。

sentences.en: Mark couldn't believe what he was hearing.
sentences.zh: 马克简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: Although he'd come to expect extreme behaviour from Sabrina, this was beyond anything he had so far endured.
sentences.zh: 尽管他已经对萨布丽娜的极端行为习以为常，但这还是超出了他迄今为止所忍受的一切。

sentences.en: He vehemently denied the lurid claims, telling police he'd never even met Sophie Leonet or communicated with her.
sentences.zh: 他强烈否认这些骇人听闻的指控，告诉警方他甚至从未见过索菲·莱奥内，也从未与她交流过。

sentences.en: He wasn't even in the country during the dates Sabrina claimed the child abuse took place.
sentences.zh: 在萨布丽娜声称发生虐童事件的期间，他甚至不在国内。

sentences.en: Mark insisted he had nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 马克坚称自己没有什么好隐瞒的。

sentences.en: He offered to provide his passport, phone, and anything else the police required to prove his innocence.
sentences.zh: 他主动提出提供自己的护照、手机以及警方证明他清白所需的任何其他东西。

sentences.en: For Mark Walton, his life changed forever in 2011 when he walked into a bank in London.
sentences.zh: 对马克·沃尔顿来说，2011年他走进伦敦的一家银行时，他的人生永远改变了。

sentences.en: Mark was a well-known figure in the music industry, having been one of the founding members of the wildly popular Irish boy band Boyzone.
sentences.zh: 马克是音乐界知名人物，曾是红极一时的爱尔兰男孩乐队Boyzone的创始成员之一。

sentences.en: He eventually left Boyzone to pursue a career in music production and had gone on to work with such artists as Jennifer Lopez and Enrique Iglesias.
sentences.zh: 他最终离开Boyzone去追求音乐制作事业，并曾与詹妮弗·洛佩兹和恩里克·伊格莱西亚斯等艺术家合作。

sentences.en: It was in the bank in London when he first laid eyes on Sabrina Quider.
sentences.zh: 正是在伦敦的那家银行里，他第一次注意到了萨布丽娜·奎德。

sentences.en: He was immediately attracted to her and they struck up a conversation.
sentences.zh: 他立刻被她吸引，两人聊了起来。

sentences.en: With good looks, style, and a common interest in the high life, the two quickly became a picture-perfect couple.
sentences.zh: 凭借出众的外表、时尚的品味以及对上流社会共同的兴趣，两人迅速成为了一对金童玉女般的伴侣。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before they moved in together and Sabrina eventually became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 没过多久他们就同居了，萨布丽娜最终怀了孕。

sentences.en: The early days of their relationship were happy, but once Mark's love goggles wore off, he saw Sabrina for who she really was.
sentences.zh: 他们恋爱的早期是幸福的，但当马克摘下爱情的有色眼镜后，他看清了萨布丽娜的真实面目。

sentences.en: She had a wild temper and her mood could dramatically switch over the most trivial of things.
sentences.zh: 她脾气暴躁，而且会为了一点鸡毛蒜皮的小事而情绪剧烈波动。

sentences.en: She often acted irrationally without explanation.
sentences.zh: 她经常莫名其妙地做出不理智的行为。

sentences.en: During some rough patches in their relationship, she called the police to report that Mark was hiring male sex workers, which was untrue.
sentences.zh: 在他们感情出现裂痕的时期，她曾报警谎称马克雇用了男性性工作者。

sentences.en: She also took to firing any nanny the pair hired to assist them, accusing them of stealing from her and of being romantically interested in Mark.
sentences.zh: 她还解雇了两人雇来协助他们的任何保姆，指控她们偷窃并对马克有浪漫企图。

sentences.en: She'd gone as far as installing hidden cameras throughout their home, which Mark was unaware of until he stumbled upon them himself.
sentences.zh: 她甚至在家里安装了隐蔽摄像头，马克直到自己无意中发现才得知此事。

sentences.en: The couple split for good in 2014, after which Sabrina rekindled her relationship with Wiesem Madunee.
sentences.zh: 2014年两人彻底分手，之后萨布丽娜与威瑟姆·马杜尼重燃旧情。

sentences.en: Mark moved to Los Angeles and continued to help support Sabrina financially, even paying the rent of her new Southfields flat.
sentences.zh: 马克搬到了洛杉矶，并继续在经济上支持萨布丽娜，甚至支付了她位于南菲尔德的新公寓的租金。

sentences.en: Regardless, she seemed determined to make his life difficult.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她似乎铁了心要让他的日子不好过。

sentences.en: Over the years, Sabrina reported Mark to the police over 30 times for a range of bizarre and baseless offences, including that he'd once tried to kill her,
sentences.zh: 多年来，萨布丽娜就各种离奇且毫无根据的罪名向警方举报马克30多次，其中包括他曾试图杀害她，

sentences.en: had hacked her phone and emails, and was trying to control her using black magic.
sentences.zh: 曾黑进她的手机和电子邮件，并试图用黑魔法控制她。

sentences.en: Things only escalated when Mark completely cut Sabrina off financially.
sentences.zh: 当马克彻底切断对萨布丽娜的经济资助时，情况更是进一步升级。

sentences.en: Amongst the many other outlandish accusations, she accused him and his friends of hiring a helicopter to spy on her.
sentences.zh: 在众多其他古怪的指控中，她指控他和他的朋友们雇直升机监视她。

sentences.en: Some of Sabrina's claims were plain ludicrous, like the times she reported Mark for sexually mistreating her cat, when she never even owned a cat in the first place.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜的一些说法简直荒谬至极，比如她曾举报马克虐待她的猫，而她根本就没养过猫。

sentences.en: The most outrageous was when Sabrina created a fake Facebook profile to publicly spread lies alleging Mark was a pedophile.
sentences.zh: 最令人发指的是，萨布丽娜创建一个假的Facebook账号，公开散布谎言，污蔑马克是个恋童癖。

sentences.en: Mark had been putting up with this issue privately for some time, after Sabrina falsely complained to social services that Mark had sexually abused their son.
sentences.zh: 此前萨布丽娜曾向社会服务机构虚假投诉马克性虐待他们的儿子，马克私下忍耐这个问题已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: But this was the first time she had accused him publicly.
sentences.zh: 但这是她第一次公开指控他。

sentences.en: Sabrina was arrested as a result, and she reluctantly accepted a caution for sending malicious communications.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜因此被捕，并勉强接受了发送恶意信息的告诫。

sentences.en: The most recent incident had occurred just one month prior to Sophie Leonet's death in August 2017.
sentences.zh: 最近的一次事件发生在2017年8月索菲·莱奥内去世前一个月。

sentences.en: Sabrina had called police to report that Sophie had taken her son to meet with Mark against her wishes.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜曾报警称，索菲不顾她的意愿，带她的儿子去见马克。

sentences.en: There, Mark threatened to kill the boy's family.
sentences.zh: 在那里，马克威胁要杀死这个男孩的家人。

sentences.en: Given Sabrina's previous history of false reports, police didn't believe her, and therefore no action was taken.
sentences.zh: 鉴于萨布丽娜过去有报假案的历史，警方并不相信她，因此没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: The following month,
sentences.zh: 第二个月，

sentences.en: Sabrina recorded a dejected and exhausted Sophie at 11.32am, mere hours before she died.
sentences.zh: 上午11点32分，萨布丽娜录下了沮丧精疲力竭的索菲，此时距离她去世仅仅几个小时。

sentences.en: She pressed Sophie to admit that Mark Walton had been at their house, despite Sophie telling her time and again that she had never met him.
sentences.zh: 她逼迫索菲承认马克·沃尔顿曾去过他们家，尽管索菲一次又一次地告诉她，她从未见过他。

sentences.en: Sabrina then told her,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜接着对她说：

sentences.en: I hate lies.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌谎言。

sentences.en: I hate, I hate, I hate lies.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌、我讨厌、我讨厌谎言。

sentences.en: So stop telling lies and tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 所以别再撒谎了，把实话告诉我。

sentences.en: For locals of Southfields, it was common to see Sophie Leonet out and about with Sabrina's children, often holding hands.
sentences.zh: 对于南菲尔德的当地人来说，经常能看到索菲·莱奥内带着萨布丽娜的孩子们外出，他们往往手牵着手。

sentences.en: It was clear that she was a hard worker and the children seemed to adore her.
sentences.zh: 很明显她工作很努力，孩子们似乎也很喜欢她。

sentences.en: Contrary to what Sabrina told police about Sophie being lazy and useless, she had been doing a standout job with the children.
sentences.zh: 与萨布丽娜向警方所说索菲懒惰无能的说法相反，她把孩子们照顾得非常出色。

sentences.en: A kind and gentle soul with unlimited patience,
sentences.zh: 她是一个善良温柔、拥有无限耐心的灵魂，

sentences.en: Sophie put enormous effort into her work, which took its toll on her.
sentences.zh: 索菲在工作上付出了巨大的努力，这损害了她的健康。

sentences.en: It wasn't in her nature to hurt anyone, especially not the very children she had been employed to look after.
sentences.zh: 伤害任何人都不是她的天性，尤其是她受雇照顾的孩子们。

sentences.en: At one point, she even helped the kids set up a mini-stand on the street to sell sweets and biscuits.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她甚至帮孩子们在街上搭了一个小摊位，用来卖糖果和饼干。

sentences.en: But in the weeks leading up to Sophie's death, neighbours had seen less and less of her.
sentences.zh: 但在索菲去世前的几周里，邻居们看到她的次数越来越少。

sentences.en: During one visit to the local fish and chip shop, owner Michael could tell by Sophie's body language that something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 有一次去当地的炸鱼薯条店时，老板迈克尔从索菲的肢体语言中看出有些不对劲。

sentences.en: He'd suspected the nanny wasn't doing well, as he noticed she often had tears in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑这位保姆过得不好，因为他注意到她眼里经常含着泪水。

sentences.en: Michael asked Sophie what was wrong, and she confided that Sabrina had beat her.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔问索菲怎么了，她倾诉说萨布丽娜打了她。

sentences.en: Michael was shocked.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔震惊了。

sentences.en: He was friendly with Sabrina Gouadère and Wiesem Medouni, as the trio were in talks of doing business together.
sentences.zh: 他和萨布丽娜·古阿德尔以及威瑟姆·梅杜尼很友好，因为这三个人当时正在商谈做生意。

sentences.en: He asked Sophie what happened to cause the beating.
sentences.zh: 他问索菲是什么事导致了挨打。

sentences.en: The reason was preposterous.
sentences.zh: 原因荒谬绝伦。

sentences.en: She had dropped the butter.
sentences.zh: 她把黄油弄掉了。

sentences.en: Michael's heart went out to Sophie.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔对索菲充满了同情。

sentences.en: He'd once seen Sabrina yelling at her on the street, but she was speaking in French, so he didn't know what she was saying.
sentences.zh: 他曾看到萨布丽娜在街上对她大喊大叫，但她说的是法语，所以他不知道她在说什么。

sentences.en: Michael offered to help Sophie find a new job and place to live, but he never saw her again.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔主动提出帮索菲找一份新工作和住处，但他再也没见过她。

sentences.en: Sabrina was also wrong in telling police that Sophie had been mingling with a rough crowd.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜告诉警方索菲和三教九流的人混在一起，这也是不对的。

sentences.en: Truth was, she had barely socialised with anyone outside of Sabrina's home.
sentences.zh: 事实是，她几乎不怎么和萨布丽娜家以外的人社交。

sentences.en: Southfields was full of other foreign nannies, many of whom bonded together, but Sophie mostly kept to herself.
sentences.zh: 南菲尔德到处都是其他外国保姆，其中许多人关系密切，但索菲大多独来独往。

sentences.en: Some noticed that Sabrina took advantage of Sophie's soft nature by making her work long hours and take on additional duties like cooking and cleaning.
sentences.zh: 一些人注意到，萨布丽娜利用索菲温和的性格，让她长时间工作，并承担做饭和打扫卫生等额外职责。

sentences.en: Sophie was particularly shy and quiet, which made her vulnerable to exploitation.
sentences.zh: 索菲性格格外害羞内向，这使她容易受到剥削。

sentences.en: A family friend named Stephen witnessed Sabrina screaming at Sophie in French on several occasions.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫斯蒂芬的家庭朋友曾多次目睹萨布丽娜用法语对索菲尖叫。

sentences.en: Sophie looked scared and hungry, as though she was in some kind of trance.
sentences.zh: 索菲看起来又惊恐又饥饿，就像处于某种出神状态一样。

sentences.en: Stephen was so concerned that Sophie wasn't eating enough that he once brought food over for her.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬非常担心索菲吃不饱，以至于有一次特意给她带了食物。

sentences.en: He confronted Sabrina about her aggressive behaviour, but Sabrina said that Sophie was lazy and didn't do enough cooking.
sentences.zh: 他曾质问萨布丽娜的攻击性行为，但萨布丽娜却说索菲很懒，饭做不够。

sentences.en: A former friend of Sabrina's named Nicole once visited the home to find Sophie on the floor and Sabrina attacking her.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜的前朋友妮可曾去过她家，发现索菲躺在地板上，萨布丽娜正在袭击她。

sentences.en: Nicole had to intervene as Sabrina tried to kick Sophie and hit her with a chair.
sentences.zh: 当萨布丽娜试图踢索菲并用椅子打她时，妮可不得不进行干预。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Nicole was so worried about Sophie that she took her into her own home with the intention of helping her get back to France.
sentences.zh: 事后，妮可非常担心索菲，便把她接到自己家里，打算帮她回法国。

sentences.en: Sabrina found out about it and turned up on Nicole's doorstep, quote, screaming like a madwoman.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜发现了这件事，找上门来，用她的话说，“像疯女人一样尖叫”。

sentences.en: She stormed in and demanded Sophie get her stuff and return to the flat.
sentences.zh: 她闯了进来，要求索菲收拾东西回公寓。

sentences.en: Nicole asked Sabrina to calm down, but she was so livid that even Nicole was terrified of her.
sentences.zh: 妮可让萨布丽娜冷静下来，但她实在是太愤怒了，连妮可都对她感到害怕。

sentences.en: The extent of what Sophie Leonay was enduring in London was a secret she never revealed to her family in any of her correspondence to them back home.
sentences.zh: 索菲·莱奥内当时在伦敦经受的折磨是一个秘密，在她给家人的所有家信中从未透露过。

sentences.en: Sophie was from a modest family in Troyes, a small provincial town in northeast France.
sentences.zh: 索菲来自法国东北部一个小省城特鲁瓦的一个朴素家庭。

sentences.en: It was the lack of employment opportunities in Troyes that had brought her to London in the first place.
sentences.zh: 正是特鲁瓦缺乏就业机会，才促使她来到伦敦。

sentences.en: A qualified childcare worker, she believed that a temporary move would kickstart her career and give her the chance to improve her English.
sentences.zh: 作为一名合格的儿童保育员，她认为暂时的搬迁能让自己的职业生涯有个良好的开端，并给她提供提高英语水平的机会。

sentences.en: The prospect of life in the big city excited Sophie.
sentences.zh: 大城市的生活前景让索菲感到兴奋。

sentences.en: She loved the arts and sought a life surrounded by cinema, dance and theatre.
sentences.zh: 她热爱艺术，渴望过一种被电影、舞蹈和戏剧包围的生活。

sentences.en: She responded to an ad to work as a live-in nanny and was thrilled to be hired by Sabrina Quader.
sentences.zh: 她应聘了一份住家保姆的工作，并对被萨布丽娜·奎德录用感到兴奋不已。

sentences.en: The glamorous woman and her celebrity-studded lifestyle played perfectly into Sophie's dream image of what life in London would be like.
sentences.zh: 这位迷人的女性及其星光熠熠的生活方式完美契合了索菲对伦敦生活的梦想图景。

sentences.en: In 2016, just days after her 20th birthday,
sentences.zh: 2016年，就在她20岁生日几天后，

sentences.en: Sophie left France and moved into Sabrina's flat on Wimbledon Park Road.
sentences.zh: 索菲离开法国，搬进了萨布丽娜位于温布尔登公园路的公寓。

sentences.en: The job started off well.
sentences.zh: 这份工作一开始很顺利。

sentences.en: Sophie got along with Sabrina's sons and looked forward to earning a decent wage.
sentences.zh: 索菲和萨布丽娜的儿子们相处得很好，并期待着赚取一份可观的薪水。

sentences.en: Sabrina even gave her a glamorous makeover, which Sophie proudly showed off on social media.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜甚至给她做了个迷人的大改造，索菲自豪地在社交媒体上展示了这一点。

sentences.en: But after about a year,
sentences.zh: 但在大约一年后，

sentences.en: Sophie told her parents she was bored and wanted to come home.
sentences.zh: 索菲告诉父母她觉得很无聊，想回家。

sentences.en: She said there were tensions in the family and it was getting harder to take care of the children.
sentences.zh: 她说家里有矛盾，照顾孩子变得越来越难。

sentences.en: She was made to sleep in the same bedroom as Sabrina's sons, which meant she had little time to herself.
sentences.zh: 她被迫和萨布丽娜的儿子们睡在同一个卧室里，这意味着她几乎没有属于自己的时间。

sentences.en: She also told her mother, Catherine, that she was not being paid.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉母亲凯瑟琳，她没有拿到工资。

sentences.en: Catherine voiced these concerns to Sabrina, who reassured her that Sophie was being paid into an English bank account.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳向萨布丽娜表达了这些担忧，萨布丽娜安慰她，称索菲的工资一直打入一个英国银行账户。

sentences.en: Police tried to find the English bank account that Sabrina claimed Sophie was being paid into, but it didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 警方试图寻找萨布丽娜声称向其支付索菲工资的那个英国银行账户，但根本不存在。

sentences.en: It didn't appear that Sophie was being paid at all.
sentences.zh: 索菲似乎根本没有拿到工资。

sentences.en: Sabrina also urged Catherine to encourage her daughter to stay on, explaining she thought of Sophie like a sister and needed her around.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜还敦促凯瑟琳鼓励女儿留下来，解释说她把索菲当成亲妹妹看待，需要她在身边。

sentences.en: It was clear that the feeling wasn't mutual when Sophie suddenly asked her mother for money so she could return to France.
sentences.zh: 当索菲突然向母亲要钱以便回法国时，很显然这种感觉并不是相互的。

sentences.en: Catherine obliged, but Sophie never ended up purchasing a ticket home.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳答应了，但索菲最终也没有买成回家的车票。

sentences.en: Sophie's parents were devastated to learn the truth of what their daughter had endured in London.
sentences.zh: 得知女儿在伦敦所经历的真相，索菲的父母悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Had they known she was in any kind of trouble, they would have immediately travelled to help her.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道她遇到了什么麻烦，就会立刻动身去帮助她。

sentences.en: Investigators remained unconvinced that what they were being told was the full truth of what happened to Sophie.
sentences.zh: 调查人员仍然不相信他们听到的就是索菲遭遇的全部真相。

sentences.en: They ultimately charged both Wiesem Madunee and Sabrina Quader with her murder and the obstruction of her body.
sentences.zh: 他们最终以谋杀罪和藏匿尸体罪起诉了威瑟姆·马杜尼和萨布丽娜·奎德。

sentences.en: The couple continued to assert that Wiesem interrogated Sophie alone and that her death was accidental.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇坚称是威瑟姆独自审讯了索菲，她的死是个意外。

sentences.en: In the lead up to their trial,
sentences.zh: 在审判前夕，

sentences.en: Wiesem offered to plead guilty to manslaughter, but the request was denied.
sentences.zh: 威瑟姆提出以过失杀人罪认罪，但遭到拒绝。

sentences.en: Three days later, he turned the case upside down when he retracted his confession, claiming he'd been lying all along to protect Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 三天后，他推翻了自己的供词，声称自己一直在撒谎以保护萨布丽娜，从而将案件彻底颠覆。

sentences.en: Those who knew the couple were aware the relationship between Sabrina and Wiesem wasn't entirely even-handed.
sentences.zh: 认识这对夫妇的人都知道，萨布丽娜和威瑟姆之间的关系并不完全对等。

sentences.en: Some friends thought Wiesem was, quote, punching above his weight, which led him to accept less-than-ideal treatment from Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 一些朋友认为威瑟姆用他们的话说是“高攀了”，这导致他接受了萨布丽娜并非理想的对待。

sentences.en: Over the years, when she left him for other men,
sentences.zh: 多年来，每当她为其他男人离开他时，

sentences.en: Wiesem always welcomed her back.
sentences.zh: 威瑟姆总是欢迎她回来。

sentences.en: The truth, according to Wiesem, was that on the evening of Monday September 18, he'd been asleep when Sabrina suddenly woke him up.
sentences.zh: 据威瑟姆供述，事实是，在9月18日星期一的晚上，他正在睡觉，萨布丽娜突然把他叫醒。

sentences.en: She kept repeating, what have I done?
sentences.zh: 她不停地重复：我做了什么？

sentences.en: What have I done?
sentences.zh: 我做了什么？

sentences.en: She told him Sophie was in the bath and wasn't breathing.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他索菲在浴缸里，已经没有呼吸了。

sentences.en: Wiesem got up and found Sophie's lifeless body lying in the tub.
sentences.zh: 威瑟姆起身发现索菲毫无生气的身体躺在浴缸里。

sentences.en: He spent over an hour trying to revive her, but it was too late.
sentences.zh: 他花了一个多小时试图救活她，但为时已晚。

sentences.en: She was already dead.
sentences.zh: 她已经死了。

sentences.en: Sabrina refused to call the police, suggesting they burned Sophie's body instead.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜拒绝报警，反而提议烧掉索菲的尸体。

sentences.en: Wiesem eventually relented because he wanted to protect Sabrina and to keep her family together.
sentences.zh: 威瑟姆最终屈服了，因为他想保护萨布丽娜并维持这个家庭的完整。

sentences.en: He put Sophie's body in a suitcase and agreed to lie to the police.
sentences.zh: 他把苏菲的尸体塞进手提箱，并同意向警方撒谎。

sentences.en: In his written statement,
sentences.zh: 在他的书面陈述中，

sentences.en: Wiesem said,
sentences.zh: 维塞姆表示：

sentences.en: I have always loved Sabrina and tried to protect her.
sentences.zh: 我一直爱着萨布丽娜，并试图保护她。

sentences.en: This led me to make very regrettable choices.
sentences.zh: 这导致我做出非常令人遗憾的选择。

sentences.en: I should have been more assertive with Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我本该对萨布丽娜更坚定一些。

sentences.en: Had I been,
sentences.zh: 如果我这么做了，

sentences.en: Sophie Leone would probably still be alive.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·莱昂内可能现在还活着。

sentences.en: Wiesem went on to paint Sabrina as the hard cop when dealing with Sophie.
sentences.zh: 维塞姆接着将萨布丽娜描绘成在对付苏菲时唱红脸的人。

sentences.en: On one occasion,
sentences.zh: 有一次，

sentences.en: Sabrina had forced Sophie into the bath and held her head under water in bid of extracting a confession about Mark Walton.
sentences.zh: 为了逼供马克·沃尔顿的事，萨布丽娜强行将苏菲按在浴缸里，并把她的头按在水下。

sentences.en: On another, she hit Sophie with an electric cable so hard in the legs that she couldn't stand or walk properly.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，她用电线狠狠抽打苏菲的腿，导致她无法站立或正常行走。

sentences.en: Wiesem admitted that he'd done nothing to stop the attacks or seek medical help for Sophie.
sentences.zh: 维塞姆承认，他没有采取任何行动阻止这些袭击，也没有为苏菲寻求医疗帮助。

sentences.en: Sabrina had fully convinced him that Sophie was helping
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜完全说服了他，让她相信苏菲正在协助

sentences.en: Mark Walton sexually abuse
sentences.zh: 马克·沃尔顿性虐待

sentences.en: Sabrina's sons.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜的儿子们。

sentences.en: He maintained that he had never hurt Sophie himself or been involved with any of the acts on the night she was killed.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己从未亲手伤害过苏菲，也没有参与她遇害当晚的任何行径。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案情档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案情档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Investigators viewed
sentences.zh: 调查人员对

sentences.en: Wiesem's confession with scepticism.
sentences.zh: 维塞姆的供词持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: By this point, they had spoken to Sabrina's youngest son, the one at the centre of the allegations against Sophie and Mark Walton.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们已经与萨布丽娜的小儿子交谈过，也就是针对苏菲和马克·沃尔顿指控的核心人物。

sentences.en: For the sake of clarity,
sentences.zh: 为清晰起见，

sentences.en: Casefile will refer to him as Gareth.
sentences.zh: 《案情档案》将称他为加雷斯。

sentences.en: On the night of Monday
sentences.zh: 在周一的夜晚

sentences.en: September 18,
Gareth woke up to the sound of noises coming from the family bedroom.
sentences.zh: 加雷斯被主卧室传出的声响吵醒了。

sentences.en: He got up to see what was going on and noticed there was water spilling out from underneath the bathroom door.
sentences.zh: 他起身查看情况，发现浴室门底正有水溢出来。

sentences.en: Inside,
sentences.zh: 在里面，

sentences.en: Gareth could hear the voices of his mother and stepfather.
sentences.zh: 加雷斯听到了他母亲和继父的声音。

sentences.en: He also heard the sound of water splashing and Sophie crying.
sentences.zh: 他还听到水花泼溅的声音和苏菲的哭泣声。

sentences.en: The next morning, he noticed his mother seemed happy and relaxed.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他发现母亲显得很高兴、很放松。

sentences.en: Gareth asked what had happened and Sabrina told him that Sophie was gone and they wouldn't be seeing her again.
sentences.zh: 加雷斯问发生了什么事，萨布丽娜告诉他苏菲已经走了，他们以后再也见不到她了。

sentences.en: Gareth's statements placed both Sabrina and Wiesem at the scene of the crime, completely shattering the narrative that one of them acted alone in assaulting Sophie
sentences.zh: 加雷斯的陈述将萨布丽娜和维塞姆双双置于犯罪现场，彻底粉碎了其中一人在苏菲遭袭时睡觉、

sentences.en: while the other person slept.
sentences.zh: 而另一人单独动手的说法。

sentences.en: With the couple refusing to tell the truth, investigators were left to charge them both with murder and piece together their own conclusions based on the evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于这对夫妇拒绝说出真相，调查人员只好以谋杀罪起诉两人，并根据证据自行拼凑出结论。

sentences.en: They believed that the couple had essentially held Sophie prisoner inside their home for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这对夫妇实际上将苏菲软禁在家中长达六周。

sentences.en: During this time, they confiscated her phone so she couldn't contact anyone without Sabrina being present.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他们没收了她的手机，这样她在萨布丽娜不在场的情况下就无法联系任何人。

sentences.en: They withheld food until Sophie would say or agree with whatever they demanded just to eat.
sentences.zh: 他们克扣食物，直到苏菲为了能吃上饭而答应或顺从他们提出的任何要求。

sentences.en: They also forced her to sleep in a tiny dark room where she withered away.
sentences.zh: 他们还强迫她睡在一个狭小黑暗的房间里，使她日渐消瘦。

sentences.en: They interrogated her so intensely and violently that they eventually wore her down enough to extract a false confession which they dictated to her as she wrote it down.
sentences.zh: 他们对她进行了极其高强度和暴力的审讯，最终彻底击垮了她的意志，逼迫她写下了由他们口授的虚假供词。

sentences.en: They likely aimed to use the confession to blackmail
sentences.zh: 他们很可能是想利用这份供词来敲诈

sentences.en: Mark Walton into giving them more money.
sentences.zh: 马克·沃尔顿，让他给他们更多的钱。

sentences.en: Sophie said and did everything the couple wanted in an effort to survive even if she knew it wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 为了活命，苏菲对这对夫妇的要求言听计从，哪怕她明知那些都不是真的。

sentences.en: Exactly how Sophie died and who had killed her remained a mystery.
sentences.zh: 苏菲究竟是如何死去的以及是谁杀了他，仍然是一个谜。

sentences.en: It also wasn't clear if she had been killed by accident during one of the torture sessions or if the couple decided she had to die.
sentences.zh: 目前也不清楚她是在某次酷刑中被意外杀害，还是这对夫妇决定必须置她于死地。

sentences.en: Either way, police believe
sentences.zh: 无论如何，警方认为

sentences.en: Sabrina and Weesom collectively put
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜和维塞姆共同将

sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜被诊断出患有抑郁症和边缘型人格障碍。

sentences.zh: 后者以情绪和心境不稳定、缺乏安全感以及冲动为特征，可能导致社交关系受损。

sentences.zh: 他们对马克·沃尔顿那种不健康的、狭隘的、全神贯注且毫无根据的痴迷剥夺了他们的理智，把苏菲变成了一个连人都不如的东西。

sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜对维塞姆有很大的影响，但这在宏观大局上并不重要。

sentences.zh: 维塞姆是一个聪明且受过良好教育的人，他知道苏菲处于危险之中，却没有做任何事情来帮助她或制止虐待行为。

sentences.zh: 法官在理解萨布丽娜的精神疾病起到一定作用的同时，断定她的行为最终是由残忍和对马克·沃尔顿的复仇欲望所驱动的。

sentences.en: The couple's case has since been labelled an example of folie adieu, a rare psychiatric syndrome where two individuals share an identical delusion.
